pages.description: Revenue minus network expense minus cost to serve, in US dollars, defined once in the margin ledger metric view.
pages.body:
## Definition
Revenue minus network expense minus cost to serve for a customer x product x circuit x month, US dollars.

## Formula / rule
| Source | Logic |
|---|---|
| `cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_ledger_mv` measure `contribution_margin` | `SUM(revenue_usd) - SUM(network_expense_usd) - SUM(cost_to_serve_usd)` |

Defined ONCE (DEC-002). Never redefine it in a dashboard, Genie instruction, app, or agent. The ledger table does not store it.

## Owner
Finance

## Linked assets
- `cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_ledger_mv` (contribution_margin, cm_pct)
- `cdm_tmforum.revenue_assurance.margin_ledger` (revenue_usd, network_expense_usd, cost_to_serve_usd)

## Example Margin Genie question
Which product families lost money after cost to serve last quarter?

## Certification criterion
margin_ledger_mv contribution_margin equals raw SQL over margin_ledger in P2-MV-VALIDATION.

pages.description: Billed revenue for a circuit in a month, in US dollars, from Lakelink Fiber customer billing.
pages.body:
## Definition
Amount billed to the customer for the circuit in the month, US dollars.

## Formula / rule
| Source | Logic |
|---|---|
| `margin_ledger_mv` measure `revenue` | `SUM(revenue_usd)` |
| `margin_billing` | `billed_amount_usd` rolled to customer x circuit x month |

## Owner
Finance

## Linked assets
- `cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_ledger_mv`
- `cdm_tmforum.revenue_assurance.margin_ledger.revenue_usd`
- `cdm_tmforum.revenue_assurance.margin_billing.billed_amount_usd`

## Example Margin Genie question
What was total revenue by product family last quarter?

## Certification criterion
Ledger revenue ties to GL revenue accounts (account_class = revenue) within 0.5%.

pages.description: Monthly cost to carry a circuit: carrier paid amount for off-net circuits plus on-net network cost, in US dollars.
pages.body:
## Definition
Direct cost of carrying the circuit in the month: paid carrier invoices for off-net circuits plus on-net network cost, US dollars.

## Formula / rule
| Source | Logic |
|---|---|
| `margin_ledger_mv` measure `network_expense` | `SUM(network_expense_usd)` |
| `margin_carrier_invoices` | `paid_amount_usd` (off-net) |

## Owner
Finance (with Ops)

## Linked assets
- `cdm_tmforum.revenue_assurance.margin_ledger.network_expense_usd`
- `cdm_tmforum.revenue_assurance.margin_carrier_invoices.paid_amount_usd`

## Example Margin Genie question
What do we pay third-party carriers per month by vendor?

## Certification criterion
Ledger network expense ties to GL network_expense accounts within 0.5%.

pages.description: Indirect operating cost (field ops, NOC, customer care, billing ops) allocated to each circuit by the active allocation rules, in US dollars.
pages.body:
## Definition
Share of indirect cost pools allocated to a customer x product x circuit x month by the active allocation rules, US dollars.

## Formula / rule
For each cost pool: pool amount (margin_gl_actuals, account_class = cost_to_serve_pool) x rule weight x the circuit's share of the driver. Summed over pools. Recomputed whenever margin_allocation_rules changes (demo scene 3).

| Source | Logic |
|---|---|
| `margin_ledger_mv` measure `cost_to_serve` | `SUM(cost_to_serve_usd)` |

## Owner
Finance

## Linked assets
- `cdm_tmforum.revenue_assurance.margin_ledger.cost_to_serve_usd`
- `cdm_tmforum.revenue_assurance.margin_allocation_rules`
- `cdm_tmforum.revenue_assurance.margin_gl_actuals.cost_pool`

## Example Margin Genie question
How much cost to serve is allocated to legacy products?

## Certification criterion
Allocated total equals cost pool totals in margin_gl_actuals for the month.

pages.description: A Finance-owned rule that spreads one cost pool across circuits using a driver and a weight.
pages.body:
## Definition
One row in margin_allocation_rules: cost_pool, driver, weight, effective dates, is_active. Weights per cost pool sum to 1.

## Formula / rule
Only active rules (is_active = TRUE, effective_from <= month < COALESCE(effective_to, open)) are used. Changing a weight changes cost to serve and contribution margin everywhere.

## Owner
Finance (rule_owner = Finance)

## Linked assets
- `cdm_tmforum.revenue_assurance.margin_allocation_rules`
- `cdm_tmforum.revenue_assurance.margin_ledger.allocation_rule_version`

## Example Margin Genie question
Which allocation rules are active for the NOC cost pool?

## Certification criterion
Weights per active cost pool sum to 1.000000.

pages.description: A bucket of indirect operating cost (field_ops, noc, customer_care, billing_ops) that is allocated to circuits as cost to serve.
pages.body:
## Definition
A group of GL costs that cannot be traced directly to a circuit and is allocated by rule. Values: field_ops, noc, customer_care, billing_ops.

## Formula / rule
Pool amount = SUM(margin_gl_actuals.amount_usd) WHERE account_class = 'cost_to_serve_pool', by cost_pool and month.

## Owner
Finance

## Linked assets
- `cdm_tmforum.revenue_assurance.margin_gl_actuals.cost_pool`
- `cdm_tmforum.revenue_assurance.margin_allocation_rules.cost_pool`

## Example Margin Genie question
What is the monthly size of each cost pool?

## Certification criterion
Every cost_pool in rules exists in GL actuals and vice versa.

pages.description: The activity measure used to split a cost pool across circuits, such as circuit_count, ticket_count, bandwidth_mbps, or billed_revenue.
pages.body:
## Definition
The quantity used to apportion a cost pool. Allowed: circuit_count, ticket_count, bandwidth_mbps, billed_revenue.

## Formula / rule
Circuit share = circuit driver value / total driver value for the month.

## Owner
Finance

## Linked assets
- `cdm_tmforum.revenue_assurance.margin_allocation_rules.driver`

## Example Margin Genie question
Which driver allocates customer care cost?

## Certification criterion
Every driver value in rules is computable from ledger inputs.

pages.description: The minimum acceptable contribution margin percentage for a product, set by Finance (default 20%).
pages.body:
## Definition
Minimum acceptable contribution margin % for a product (margin_products.margin_floor_pct, 0.2000 = 20%).

## Formula / rule
A contract line is below the floor when its cm_pct < margin_floor_pct. Renewals in the next 90 days = term_end in [as_of, as_of + 90 days).

## Owner
Finance sets it; Sales uses it

## Linked assets
- `cdm_tmforum.revenue_assurance.margin_products.margin_floor_pct`
- `cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_renewal_floor_mv`

## Example Margin Genie question
Which renewals in the next 90 days are below the margin floor?

## Certification criterion
Below-floor list from the metric view matches raw SQL.

pages.body:

pages.description: Expected revenue minus billed revenue: money Lakelink Fiber earned under contract but did not bill.
pages.body:
## Definition
Expected revenue (contract rate x period) minus billed revenue, US dollars. Positive = under-billing.

## Formula / rule
| Source | Logic |
|---|---|
| `margin_ledger` | `SUM(expected_revenue_usd) - SUM(revenue_usd)` |
| `margin_billing` | `expected_amount_usd - billed_amount_usd` |

## Owner
Finance

## Linked assets
- `cdm_tmforum.revenue_assurance.margin_billing`
- `cdm_tmforum.revenue_assurance.margin_ledger.expected_revenue_usd`

## Example Margin Genie question
How much revenue leakage did we have last quarter by customer?

## Certification criterion
Metric view leakage equals raw SQL over margin_billing.

pages.description: Carrier invoiced rate minus the contracted vendor rate for an off-net circuit; positive means the carrier billed above contract.
pages.body:
## Definition
invoiced_rate_usd - vendor_contract_rate_usd per carrier invoice line, US dollars. 0 for on-net circuits.

## Formula / rule
| Source | Logic |
|---|---|
| `margin_ledger` | `SUM(carrier_rate_variance_usd)` |
| `margin_carrier_invoices` | `invoiced_rate_usd - vendor_contract_rate_usd` |

## Owner
Ops (AP disputes)

## Linked assets
- `cdm_tmforum.revenue_assurance.margin_carrier_invoices`
- `cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_rate_variance_mv` (planned)

## Example Margin Genie question
Which vendors billed above contract rate last month?

## Certification criterion
Metric view variance equals raw SQL over margin_carrier_invoices.

pages.description: Moving an off-net circuit onto Lakelink Fiber's own network to remove the carrier cost.
pages.body:
## Definition
Migrating an off-net circuit that runs next to Lakelink fiber (is_parallel_to_onnet_fiber = TRUE) onto the on-net network. Savings = carrier monthly cost avoided less on-net cost.

## Formula / rule
Scored by UC function `cdm_tmforum.revenue_assurance.margin_score_onnet_move`; the grooming agent drafts a savings ticket that Ops approves in the Margin Truth app.

## Owner
Ops

## Linked assets
- `cdm_tmforum.revenue_assurance.margin_circuits` (is_parallel_to_onnet_fiber, onnet_distance_m)
- `cdm_tmforum.revenue_assurance.margin_score_onnet_move`

## Example Margin Genie question
Which off-net circuits are the best grooming candidates by monthly savings?

## Certification criterion
Function savings for a sample circuit match manual calculation.

pages.description: Lakelink Fiber's target of 1 billion US dollars in annualized margin improvement, tracked by lever.
pages.body:
## Definition
Lakelink Fiber's target of USD 1,000,000,000 in annualized contribution margin improvement, tracked by lever (grooming, rate variance recovery, leakage recovery, legacy repricing, renewal floor).

## Formula / rule
Progress = SUM of annualized identified savings by lever / 1,000,000,000. Shown on the Margin Truth dashboard $1B Wall page and challenge cards.

## Owner
Finance (CFO)

## Linked assets
- `cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_onebillion_wall_mv` (wall_target, identified_savings, gap_to_wall, wall_progress_pct, baseline_contribution_margin)
- Lakelink Fiber Margin Truth AI/BI dashboard (id 01f1df1950c51bd68e87ace31632c2bf, $1B Wall page)
- `cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_ledger_mv`

## Example Margin Genie question
Which lever contributes most to the $1B Wall?

## Certification criterion
Dashboard lever totals equal metric view values.

pages.description: A Lakelink Fiber customer segment whose contribution margin % is above the portfolio average while its revenue share is below its customer-count share (DEC-013).
pages.body:
## Definition
A customer segment has room to grow when its contribution margin % is above the portfolio contribution margin % AND its revenue share is below its customer-count share (DEC-013).

## Formula / rule
revenue_share = segment revenue / total portfolio revenue; customer_share = segment customers / total customers; room_to_grow = 'Yes' when segment cm_pct > portfolio_cm_pct AND revenue_share < customer_share. Contribution margin comes from MEASURE() over margin_ledger_mv (DEC-002) and is never redefined.

## Owner
Marketing (definition owner for contribution margin: Finance)

## Linked assets
- `cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_segment_growth_mv` (room_to_grow, cm_pct, revenue_share, customer_share, room_to_grow_segment_count, portfolio_cm_pct)
- `cdm_tmforum._metrics.margin_ledger_mv`

## Example Margin Genie question
Which segments have the highest margin and the most room to grow?

## Certification criterion
room_to_grow flags in the metric view match the DEC-013 rule recomputed in raw SQL.
